methods.label: Group conformal, random groups
methods.description: Proposed: adaptive robust plan over a group conformal set with random circuit groups.

methods.label: Group conformal, fixed groups
methods.description: Adaptive robust plan; circuit groups follow fixed service regions.

methods.label: Group conformal, oracle groups
methods.description: Adaptive robust plan; groups built from the simulator's spatial blocks.

methods.label: Bonferroni
methods.description: Adaptive robust plan; per-circuit conformal bounds at a Bonferroni-corrected level.

methods.label: Max-rank
methods.description: Adaptive robust plan; per-circuit bounds with the max-rank multiple-testing correction.

methods.label: Normal CI
methods.description: Adaptive robust plan; per-circuit normal-approximation intervals, Bonferroni split.

methods.label: Co-optimized (no uncertainty set)
methods.description: Plans and PSPS optimized together against the predicted mean ignitions only.

methods.label: Planning only
methods.description: Sectionalization and fast-trip placed on the highest predicted hazard; PSPS decided later.

parameters.label: Sectionalization budget
parameters.description: Largest share of the study circuits that can be sectionalized.

parameters.label: Fast-trip budget
parameters.description: Largest share of the study circuits that can carry fast-trip settings.

parameters.label: SAIFI cap
parameters.description: Cap on mitigation interruptions per customer from fast-trip and PSPS combined.

parameters.label: Fast-trip effectiveness
parameters.description: Share of a protected circuit's ignition exposure that fast-trip removes.

parameters.label: Fast-trip SAIFI factor
parameters.description: Reliability cost of fast-trip relative to one PSPS event on the same circuit.
